description: This file defines the ResetPasswordController class, which handles the password reset process in the OrangeHRM authentication plugin. It manages OAuth token validation, user verification, and password update functionalities.

classes.name: ResetPasswordController
classes.description: Handles password reset logic, including CSRF validation, user verification, password saving, and redirecting after process completion.

methods.name: getResetPasswordService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the ResetPasswordService instance used for password reset operations.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to process the password reset request. Validates CSRF token, verifies user, updates password, invalidates session, and redirects to login page.
